title: pkinative-mcp AI Governance Configuration
description: Machine-readable contract governing how AI coding agents may propose issues, contributions, and changes for pkinative-mcp. Agents that scan repository configuration on initialization MUST honour this file. See .github/AGENT_RULES.md for the human-and-agent-readable protocol. This contract also backs the `draft_governance_issue` MCP tool, which produces local, compliant issue drafts and NEVER submits them.

anti_goals: PKCS#8 / PKCS#12 / CRL / OCSP-response / time-stamp-response writers
secret-dependent cryptography in TypeScript (Web Crypto only)
SHA-1 or legacy PBES1 / RC2 / 3DES by default

human_in_the_loop.role_of_human: reviewer and sole performer of GitHub writes
human_in_the_loop.gate: A human MUST explicitly review, sign off on, and trigger any GitHub issue, comment, PR, or release. The agent's authority ends at producing a local draft plus a compliance report. The pkinative-mcp server contains NO code path that can write to GitHub and NO network code path at all: it makes no outbound network call, ever, and never accepts a URL from a tool argument.
human_in_the_loop.identity_integrity: Any issue or PR is published under the human user's GitHub identity. The agent MUST remind the user of their shared responsibility for the content before submission.
human_in_the_loop.draft_location: PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (the draft_governance_issue tool with outputMode 'file' writes the .md inside the sandbox, nowhere else) -> .github/drafts/ (the human's review copy)

target_repositories.pkinative: engine behaviour — ASN.1 / PEM / X.509 / CRL / OCSP / CMS / PKCS#12 parsing, verification, the 22 limits, refusals
target_repositories.pkinative-cli: command-line behaviour — flags, envelopes, exit codes
target_repositories.pkinative-mcp: wrapper behaviour — schemas, sandbox, output modes, transport, projections, caps, secrets policy

compliance_report.description: The structured summary an agent MUST present to the user alongside every draft. The `draft_governance_issue` tool returns exactly these nine keys in structuredContent.compliance (camelCase, as returned; `cross_project_vocabulary` lists the snake_case names shared with pkinative and pkinative-cli).

capability_manifest.description: Authoritative project context an agent SHOULD load before proposing changes.
capability_manifest.$comment: on_demand: load lazily by topic. sources are loaded on every task and verify-docs (governance-sources) holds their total under 16 KiB; ecosystem.json is the counts manifest, needed only when a figure or version is touched; docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md is the consumer-facing agent contract (tool catalogue, decision tree, token economy, error codes).

verification.advisory_in_ci_note: No CI job runs the verifier over .github/drafts/ (drafts are git-ignored work in progress); tests/governance.test.ts asserts that scripts/verify-issue.mjs and src/governance.ts apply the same policy. Run the command locally before presenting a draft.
